title: 第975章 幸运突破第974章 幸运异常
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
“怎么回事？详细说来！”林潜眸光一凝，沉声开口，语气带着几分沉肃。
幸运伴随他许久，灵性十足、温顺乖巧，现在出现异常异动，绝非小事，容不得半点轻视。
阿大四人站成一排，身姿紧绷，大气不敢喘一口。
队列末尾的阿四深吸一口气，上前半步，躬身垂首，语气带着难以掩饰的后怕与凝重，缓缓道出始末：“公子，自您离开朝阳峰后，便一直是小人负责照料幸运的起居，打理它日常吸纳灵石、调息诸事。”
“约莫一个月前，幸运如常吸纳灵石中的灵气，调息修行。突然幸运发出鸣叫声，身躯剧烈震颤，周身灵气狂暴紊乱。下一瞬，它后背虚空之中，突兀浮现一张狰狞恐怖的漆黑鬼脸，面目扭曲、獠牙外露，煞气森森，让人望之心神剧震。”说到此处，阿四眼底掠过一丝惊惧，显然当日的一幕至今让他心有余悸。
“那张鬼脸毫无征兆，一闪而没，径直没入幸运脊背之中！鬼脸入体的刹那，幸运周身骤然亮起一层诡异黑光，性情瞬间大变，温顺尽失，变得极为狂躁暴戾。不等小人反应，它身形一晃，瞬间消失在我眼前，速度快得连残影都无法捕捉。”
阿四声音微微发颤，回想当日惊悚一幕，依旧心绪难平：“事发突然，小人当即满山搜寻，从白天一直寻至深夜，翻遍周遭，始终找不到幸运半点踪迹。”
“小人不敢耽搁，连忙返回告知阿大三位师兄。随后我四人不眠不休、昼夜搜寻，耗费整整三天三夜，将整座朝阳峰的山林沟壑、崖壁洞穴尽数翻遍，最终在峰内一处偏僻无人的幽谷深处，找到了幸运的踪迹。”
“不过？”话说至此，阿四话语一顿，面露迟疑，语气显得忐忑犹豫。
“不过什么？”林潜眉心紧蹙，连忙追问。
阿四垂首拱手，如实禀报：“不过幸运已然彻底变了模样，性情极度急躁暴戾，极具攻击性。我等但凡踏入那处山谷，它便会骤然发难、主动袭杀，攻势凌厉迅猛。以我四人如今的修为，根本无法近身半步，更别说将它带回。”
“只是公子放心，我等未曾懈怠，每日都会定时前往谷口放置灵石，供它吸纳，从未间断。”
林潜闻言默然，心中了然。
幸运虽是蛊虫，平日温顺无害、看似平平无奇，可真正爆发起来，战力也是极为不俗的。
它身法迅捷绝伦，就连真丹境修士都难以捕捉其踪迹，寻常真元境武者更是连它的衣角都触碰不到。
阿大如今不过真元境三重，其余三人皆是真元境二重，境界浅薄，挡不住发狂的幸运、无法近身看护，实属正常。
知晓前因后果，林潜心中隐隐有了些许猜测。
不过也需要他亲眼看到幸运，才能断定心中猜测。
“你们四人前方带路，带我去那处山谷。”林潜沉声吩咐道。
“是，公子！”

阿大四人连忙躬身应下，不敢迟疑，转身朝着朝阳峰深处快步引路。
四人脚步飞快，穿行在山间密林之间。
此地人迹罕至，古木参天、藤蔓交错，林间雾气氤氲，与朝阳峰外围的清幽截然不同。
一路深入约莫半炷香的时间，前方视野骤然开阔，一处藏于群山环抱、密林深处的隐秘幽谷，缓缓展露全貌。
整座山谷入口处，被茂密的古树藤蔓遮掩，隐蔽至极，寻常弟子即便走遍朝阳峰，也难以发现此处。
谷外清风静谧，草木青翠，可一旦靠近谷口百丈范围，便隐隐透出一股阴冷死寂的气息。
谷内地面铺满厚厚的落叶，常年无人踩踏，松软湿润。
山谷中央萦绕着一层淡淡的灰黑色薄雾，轻轻流转浮动，将整片谷心笼罩其中。
雾气不浓，却自带一股森然压抑的诡异气场，隔绝内外，让人本能心生忌惮。
content_en:
"What's going on? Tell me in detail!" Lin Qian's eyes narrowed and he spoke in a deep voice, his tone a bit solemn.
Luck has been with him for a long time. He is full of spirituality, docile and well-behaved. Now that he has abnormal behavior, it is not a trivial matter and cannot be taken lightly.
The four of them stood in a row, their postures tense and they did not dare to take a breath.
Ah Si, who was at the end of the queue, took a deep breath, took half a step forward, bowed his head, and spoke slowly with an unconcealable fear and solemnity in his voice: "Sir, since you left Chaoyang Peak, you have been a villain responsible for taking care of Lucky's daily life, taking care of its daily absorption of spiritual stones, regulating its breath, and other matters."
"About a month ago, Lucky absorbed the spiritual energy from the spiritual stone as usual and practiced breath control. Suddenly Lucky made a chirping sound, its body trembled violently, and the spiritual energy around it was violent and chaotic. The next moment, it suddenly appeared in the void on its back. A hideous and terrifying pitch-black face, with twisted features, exposed fangs, and a sinister aura that shocked people's hearts." At this point, a trace of fear flashed across Ah Si's eyes, and it was clear that the scene that day still left him with lingering fear.
"Without any warning, the ghostly face disappeared in a flash and disappeared directly into Lucky's back! The moment the ghostly face entered the body, Lucky's whole body suddenly lit up with a strange black light, and his temperament changed instantly. He lost all his meekness and became extremely manic and violent. Without waiting for the villain to react, it flickered and disappeared in front of my eyes. It was so fast that even the afterimage could not be caught."
Ah Si's voice trembled slightly, recalling the terrifying scene that day, he still couldn't calm down: "The incident happened suddenly, and the villain immediately searched all over the mountain. He searched all over the place from day to night, but couldn't find any trace of Lucky."
"I didn't dare to delay, so I hurried back to inform the three senior brothers Ah Da. Then the four of me worked around the clock and searched day and night. It took three days and three nights to search through all the forest ravines, cliffs and caves in Chaoyang Peak. Finally, we found the lucky trace deep in a remote and uninhabited valley in the peak."
"But?" At this point, Ah Si paused, his face showed hesitation, and his tone sounded hesitant.
"But what?" Lin Qian frowned and asked quickly.
Ah Si lowered his head and cupped his hands, and reported truthfully: "However, Lucky has completely changed its appearance. It is extremely impatient, violent, and extremely aggressive. Whenever we step into that valley, it will suddenly attack and attack with great force and speed. With the current cultivation level of the four of us, we cannot get even half a step closer to it, let alone bring it back."
"Don't worry, young master, we have never slacked off. We will go to the valley entrance regularly every day to place spiritual stones for it to absorb. We have never stopped."
Lin Qian was silent when he heard the words, understanding in his heart.
Although luck is like a poisonous insect, it is usually docile and harmless, seemingly ordinary, but when it really breaks out, its combat power is also extremely impressive.
Its movement is so fast that even the true elixir realm monks can't catch its traces, and ordinary true essence realm warriors can't even touch the corners of its clothes.
Ada is now only at the third level of the True Yuan Realm, and the other three are all at the second level of the True Yuan Realm. Their realms are shallow and they cannot stop the crazy luck and cannot take close care of them. This is normal.
Knowing the cause and effect, Lin Qian had some guesses in his mind.
But he also needs to see the luck with his own eyes before he can confirm his guess.
"The four of you lead the way and take me to that valley." Lin Qian ordered in a deep voice.
"Yes, sir!"
The four members of Ah Da hurriedly bowed in agreement, without daring to hesitate, turned around and quickly led the way towards the depths of Chaoyang Peak.
The four of them walked quickly through the mountains and dense forests.
This place is inaccessible, with towering ancient trees, intertwined vines, and mist in the forest. It is completely different from the tranquility outside Chaoyang Peak.
After about half a stick of incense, the view ahead suddenly widened. A hidden valley surrounded by mountains and deep in the dense forest slowly revealed its full view.
The entrance to the entire valley is covered by dense ancient trees and vines, making it extremely hidden. Even if ordinary disciples travel all over Chaoyang Peak, it would be difficult to find this place.at.
Outside the valley, the breeze is quiet and the grass and trees are green, but once you get within a hundred feet of the entrance of the valley, there is a faint air of cold death.
The ground in the valley is covered with thick leaves, untrodden all year round, and is soft and moist.
A layer of faint gray-black mist lingers in the center of the valley, gently flowing and floating, shrouding the entire heart of the valley.
The fog is not thick, but it has a strange and depressing aura that isolates the inside and outside, making people instinctively fearful.
